title: Toast
overview: Short, non-blocking confirmation or low-priority status.
apply_when: Saved, uploaded, bundled events, something they should notice without stopping the task.
not_when: Important failure that needs a reason (modal), standing page notice (alert / site_alert), or in-flight wait (loading_indicator / button loading).

vs.why: full-width sitewide, not a floating toast

role.overview: A short status that does not fully interrupt.
role.apply_when: Something finished or a low-priority note.
role.not_when: A blocking failure (modal) or in-page alert.
A full-page confirmation they must read.

role.overview: A short warning they can miss only if that is safe.
A short failure. If they must act, consider alert or modal.
role.apply_when: A request failed and they can retry from here.
role.not_when: Form field errors (those stay on the fields / error_summary).

size.overview: Highest in the size hierarchy — the easiest to hit.
size.apply_when: The view's main instance, or full-width on a small viewport.
size.not_when: A dense toolbar or a third option next to the main control.

size.apply_when: Ordinary use in forms, pages, and chrome.
size.not_when: The only control on a mobile screen that should span the width.

size.overview: Lowest in the size hierarchy — densest.
size.apply_when: Inline or chrome that sits beside content.
size.not_when: The page's primary instance, or a control under 44×44.

composition.overview: Text only, or text plus one action.

composition.apply_when: Undo or a single next step.
composition.not_when: Two competing actions (those belong on a dialog).

state.overview: Visible. Must not steal focus unless the house says so.
state.not_when: A toast that traps the page.

state.overview: Gone. If undo was offered, the window may be over.
state.not_when: Dismissed with no way to recover a destructive action.

accessibility.overview: The message is announced. Prefer polite unless they must stop.
If there is an action, it has a name and is reachable.
accessibility.not_when: A clickable toast body with no button name.

accessibility.overview: Focus stays where they were unless the house requires otherwise.
accessibility.not_when: Focus jumped into the toast and they lost the field.

keyboard.overview: If an action exists, it is in the tab order without trapping the page.
keyboard.not_when: The toast is a focus trap.

keyboard.overview: Escape dismisses when dismiss is allowed.
